reviews.text: Great, a very attentive groomer
Thanks to Aristochiens, who have just restored my faith in Lyon's dog groomers....

It's always a pleasure to come to Les Aristochiens! The welcome is truly excellent and the results are always impeccable. My Shetland Sheepdog always comes out looking magnificent, perfectly groomed and with great care. You can really feel the professionalism and attention given to the animals. I highly recommend them, 5/5!

First experience for my 6-month-old Goldendoodle, and it was a very positive one! A very warm welcome that immediately puts you at ease! Then the whole team took excellent care of my dog! She left beautifully groomed and wasn't even in a hurry to leave the salon, which is unusual for her as she doesn't usually like being brushed! I recommend it 100%!
Does not comply with standards!

A fantastic experience at Les Aristochiens for my 10-month-old cocker spaniel's first grooming session!

The welcome was excellent and the work was truly meticulous. The result is impeccable, as you can see in the 5 photos I posted (special mention for the before/after, which speaks for itself).

A Lyon-based grooming salon that I highly recommend for its professionalism and gentleness towards animals. Thank you again! 🐾🐶

I recommend this groomer 1000%!

They are professional, very kind, and attentive.
You can tell they genuinely love taking care of the dogs entrusted to them.
You can go there with complete confidence.
Thank you so much!! As with every grooming session at your place, our Frisou looks magnificent!!!
Extremely gentle with my cocker spaniel!! Perfectly groomed
Every grooming session is perfect - everyone is extremely attentive to the dogs, and the result is just wow!

I took my 8-month-old Cocker Spaniel puppy to Aristochiens for her first grooming appointment, and I'll never go anywhere else!

She's naturally shy, even timid, but the team at the salon completely reassured her, so much so that she would have happily stayed longer! They are truly passionate about animals, know exactly how to pamper them, and, most importantly, listen to your requests.

Go there without hesitation! 🐕‍🦺

So many kindnesses!

I have a dog with a terrible temper (just like his owner), but despite my 15-minute delay and Raymond's behavior, I received a warm welcome.
On my return, I didn't recognize my little troublemaker!
Calm and magnificent, how do they do it??
Thank you so much, I highly recommend it!

And what a charming little shop!

I took my cocker spaniel to Aristochiens for her first grooming session and I'm thrilled with the result! The price was fair for the work done, the appointment was quick, and the grooming wasn't too long for our furry friends. I'll definitely be back for my dog's grooming routine 👍🏻 …

Desert him!

After 13 years of loyalty, thirteen years without ever faltering,
And now a heartless groomer dares to betray everything.
What a slap in the face to be told he no longer wants your pet,

As if age were a fault, an abnormal burden.
And yes, this dog is old—so what?
He's earned every white hair, every beat of his heart.

But he's too cowardly to welcome him anymore,
Throws away thirteen years of habit like slamming a door.

And the cherry on top of the insult?

A bill of €112 left there without a shred of shame.
Let him keep his arrogance and his cold salon,
Because what he's losing is much more than a client:
It's dignity, loyalty, honor.

The stars!
Best grooming salon by far.
In addition to their masterclass scissor work, the two owners are incredibly kind!
The best!!
I recommend them 10,000 times over!

Best grooming experience ever for my 2-year-old cocker spaniel! 🐕 I highly recommend them!
Thanks again, I'll be back! 😄 …
This is the third time I've brought my golden retriever, Bruno, and he's always treated with great care and gentleness. His coat comes out beautifully soft. Thank you.
Melba's second grooming session! I'm so happy with the result! Very professional and helpful advice! Thank you!
Anyone who loves their pet will logically avoid this establishment.
Wonderful experience with my little chihuahua, Lion. I've never seen a groomer so caring towards animals. Thank you so much for the love you give our furry friends.

First grooming session for our 4-year-old Golden Retriever...
He looked fantastic when we got him back.

He was so happy with Nicolas and Eric he almost didn't want to come home with us 😉
See you soon.

The phone call to schedule an appointment was very unpleasant.

I'm not coming to your place to be yelled at, thank you!

AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!!!!

I am extremely disappointed by this experience. The groomer's behavior was unacceptable: I witnessed violent actions towards my dog, which is completely inadmissible. My pet came back stressed and frightened, which is completely unlike him.
Entrusting your dog to a professional is, above all, about trusting them to care for it gently and respectfully—which was absolutely not the case here.
I strongly advise against this groomer for anyone concerned about their pet's well-being.

First grooming session for Iris... fantastic, professional, and wonderful with the dog... My dog ​​came out rejuvenated, soft, and fresh... ready to face the heat... thank you so much and see you soon!

Excellent, very professional. Tahaa is absolutely gorgeous! 🥰 We are very pleased, thank you for your hospitality.
Bravo!
Marcelle & Yves …
First time for our dog, who was received with love and professionalism. He left happy and looking magnificent (Shetland Sheepdog). Thank you to the whole team. See you soon!

My white Shiba Inu, Dolce, was seen today by this wonderful and patient team. It's clear our dogs are loved and treated incredibly well; on top of that, he came out looking magnificent and smelling amazing.

Top-notch team with excellent advice.

I recommend them 100%! Thank you, Aristochiens team! 🥰🐕

gave very little information over the phone and the morning of the appointment refused to cut more that an inch, arguing that dogs don't get hot or suffer from the heat anyway....would not recommend at all

Superb team, very attentive and professional; they truly love animals and their work! A very pleasant place, and the little shop is a bonus, with lots of accessories and treats! In fact, after every grooming session, my dog ​​leaves with a little treat.
My mini Yorkshire's neck is always impeccable!
Another plus is that it's always clean inside, unlike other places I've been to before. We've been returning to Les Aristochiens for several years now with great pleasure! My dog ​​🐶 and I are happy 🐾 Zahia and her mom Nika :)

Hello everyone, I wanted to commend the professionalism of this dog groomer, who was able to identify my dog's breed without me even telling him.

He also gave me very professional advice for my pet's well-being.

Unfortunately, he can't take my dog ​​today, but I'm keeping his contact information; he's invaluable in the grooming world. Well done, sir!

Chantal Partouche
Excellent groomer! Very attentive, offers great advice, and is also very friendly and well-equipped! Excellent work, of course. I highly recommend him.

Our go-to groomer in Lyon for our little pomksy, who absolutely hates water and being brushed, but somehow is always eager to go back! She always leaves with a shiny coat and a big smile. Wonderfully kind, professional and English-friendly staff, with services at an affordable price point.

I've finally found THE perfect grooming center for cocker spaniels in Lyon!

The results are impeccable. Everything went really well. Go there with your eyes closed, you'll see they're adorable.

You can really tell they're passionate about animals and take their well-being to heart. I recommend them 100%! Thanks again, see you soon!
Arno Gabai & Una

Price based on the time spent with the dog????
Without informing me beforehand that an extra charge might apply.
I am very disappointed by your lack of transparency.
€85 for my small dog…
I also asked for a haircut, not a scissor trim….
Nothing more to add.
Nicola gave my 5yr old Bernedoodle the best  cut she’s ever had & she clearly had made friends with him when I came to pick her up. I can’t recommend enough.

We needed to get our little Luna (a Pomeranian-poodle mix) groomed while living and working in Lyon for the summer and are so happy we chose Les Aristochiens. We walked in at lunchtime on a weekday and made the appointment in person for that Saturday AM. We dropped her off at 9:30am and collected her at midday. All the staff were so lovely and friendly and I can honestly say Luna has never looked better! They are true artists and I couldn’t recommend their services highly enough.

The welcome was terrible; all I got was criticism about my dog's knots. I warned him that he can be aggressive (he's a Yorkshire Terrier), and the owner barked at me, saying that if he got bitten, he'd give him back to me just like that. I reminded him that my dog ​​is epileptic, and all I got was a loud sigh and displeasure. I'd been coming here for years. The previous owner was lovely and very competent, and I always received excellent service. Plus, the price has gone up from 50 to 69 euros! That's it, I won't be back!
After grooming, your dog is a real snob...
Welcoming, smiling, and highly professional, Nicolas provides impeccable grooming. The dogs are pampered and feel completely at ease, as do their owners.
Kind and caring with the dogs. Comes home clean and well trimmed. Would recommend.
Excellent service and very professional! Tchoupie always looks gorgeous after her grooming appointment! And her coat is getting more and more beautiful! Thank you!

Excellent grooming and very professional and serious groomers! 👍🏻 My dog ​​looked fantastic when I got him back.
Very satisfied, I highly recommend them. …

When I tried to contact the owner, his employee had the nerve to tell me that he was busy and that I was bothering him.
When I asked again to speak to the store manager, he had the nerve to tell me to …
He refuses to groom my goat, tells me to put her in my bed, and speaks in a horrible way. I do not recommend him at all.
